posts.text:
I guess 'tis the day i complain about over-hype on this app.

This does not show a quadrillion param model, nor how to train one.

The claim (which is only in the blog and this thread, the paper is ok) is based on wild extrapolations, but i promise you that the techniques studied
posts.quoted: Humans are ~1,000,000x more sample efficient than LLMs, and there are no good explanations. We’ve found that a big part of the answer is that LLMs are *massively* underparameterized by many orders of magnitude. The brain has 100T synapses learning from ~200M tokens of language.
